purpose: Convert four official Euro-20 fastener STEPs (T-bolt, DIN912 cap screw, wide washer, spring washer) to meter-unit GLB; record measured local axes for later manual placement and explode-along-install-direction. Data pack only.
units_note: All STEP files use SI millimetre. GLB files are in meters (glTF convention): 0.010 m = 10 mm. For washers and the EDLA head, STEP VERTEX_POINT does not sample the full revolved solid, so the authoritative extent is the tessellated GLB mesh bbox (mm = bounds_m * 1000). Do not use VERTEX_POINT alone for EPDA/EPDB or for EDLA's Y extent.

not_the_same_sku.note: Inbox README said the typc example labelled EDLA; the official screenshot itself prints EDLG-S1-M4-L10. Earlier official TYZC ZP accessory table listed EDLA-S1-M4-L10. These are different part numbers. EDLA is a valid official DIN912 cap-screw SKU from its own product page and may be used as a shape stand-in; do not say the typc 使用示例 screw was downloaded exactly.

tpaa_finish_reminder.forbidden: Do not call a pack that uses TPAA-D the exact official ZP kit, and do not silently relabel D as N.

additions.naming_mismatch: Downloaded and selected on the page as TPBT-G-M5-L10 (镀铬). STEP FILE_NAME and PRODUCT are the numeric id 2076330136992727040. The solid name is TPBT-D-M5-L10-1-solid1 (D, not G). Asset file and GLB node are named from the page/download SKU TPBT-G-M5-L10. Do not treat the file as proven chrome-plated geometry distinct from a D body; only the page selection is G.
additions.glb_note: Cascadio produced a single mesh; the GLB is large (~2.36 MB, 50218 vertices) because the T-head region is densely tessellated. Node renamed from the numeric PRODUCT id to TPBT-G-M5-L10.

fits.note: The product page states 适用型材系列：欧标20系列, and does not separately state 槽宽系列6. Measured T-head width is 6.000 mm (file Z, ±3.0). That is a geometry measurement, not page-level confirmation of slot series 6, and not a measured insertion into a TXCJ slot.

geometry.scale_check: GLB is meters; bounds*1000 match STEP millimetre vertex bbox exactly (10 x 13.2 x 6 mm).
measured_features_for_later_manual_matin: Local shank/screw axis is the file Y axis. Tip at y=+10 mm; T-head toward negative Y.
Overall envelope 10.000 x 13.200 x 6.000 mm (file X/Y/Z).
T-head occupies y=-3.2 to about 0 (thickness 3.2 mm). Ends at |x|≈5 lie between about y=-1.40 and y=-0.08. Head length along X is 10.000 mm (±5); width along Z is 6.000 mm (±3).

M5 shank is a cylinder r=2.5 mm (Ø5) along Y. Mesh points in the r≈2.5 band occupy y=1.6 to y=9.5. Tip chamfer occupies y=9.5 to 10 (radius shrinks to about 2.25). Region y=0 to 1.6 is a wider transition (STEP also has a r=3.0 cylinder at y=1.6); this is measured, not an official shoulder callout.
Explode / install direction in file coordinates: along Y. Tip-first travel is toward +Y.

placement_axes_for_explode.axis_note: Unit direction from T-head toward the tip (file +Y).

additions.internal_solid_name_note: Solid name in the STEP is mojibake under GBK/UTF-8; PRODUCT name matches the SKU.

glb_nodes.note: Cascadio split one STEP solid into a body mesh (full 14 x 7 x 7 mm) and a shank feature (x=-10 to -0.4, 9.6 x 4 x 4 mm, Ø4). The feature is parented under the SKU node. This is the same split pattern as the batch-2 T-nuts, not a second official part.

do_not_confuse_with.reason: Different official part numbers and, in the typc figure, a different illustrated head/family. EDLA here is the DIN912 cap screw from its own page and from the earlier ZP table, not the EDLG callout printed on the typc 使用示例.

geometry.scale_check: GLB is meters. Mesh bbox 14 x 7 x 7 mm. VERTEX_POINT understates Y (only ±1.732, the hex-socket vertices) because the Ø7 head circle is not fully sampled by VERTEX_POINT; use the mesh bbox.
measured_features_for_later_manual_matin: Local screw axis is the file X axis. Socket/head face at x=-14 mm; tip at x=0 mm.

Head (points with YZ radius > 3.0 mm) occupies x=-14 to x=-10 (height 4.0 mm). Cylindrical head radius 3.5 mm (Ø7). Shank radius 2.0 mm (Ø4). Overall length 14.0 mm = 4 + 10, consistent with DIN912 M4 head plus L=10, as a measurement, not a standards-certificate claim.
Hex socket opens at x=-14. Measured hex circumradius 1.732 mm (across-flats 3.0 mm). Socket-like points extend to about x=-12 (measured depth ≈ 2.0 mm).
Shank/feature occupies about x=-10 to x=-0.4; tip chamfer occupies the last 0.4 mm to x=0.
Explode / install direction in file coordinates: along X. Tip-first insertion travels toward +X.

placement_axes_for_explode.axis_note: Unit direction from the socket/head face toward the tip (file +X).

additions.official_example: Printed as EPDA-S1W-K-4 on the typc 使用示例 left exploded view (same SKU as this download).

geometry.scale_check: GLB is meters; mesh bbox 12 x 12 x 1 mm matches the STEP cylinder radii (outer r=6.0, inner r=2.15) and thickness z=0 to 1. VERTEX_POINT is incomplete (all vertices have y=0, on one diameter only) and must not be used as the solid AABB.
measured_features_for_later_manual_matin: Hole axis is the file Z axis, centered at x=0, y=0.
Outer radius 6.0 mm (Ø12.0). Inner radius 2.15 mm (Ø4.30). Thickness 1.0 mm (z=0 to z=1).
Both faces are planar rings. No geometric evidence which face is 'up'.
Explode / stack direction in file coordinates: along Z.

additions.official_example: Printed as EPDB-S1W-B1-4 on the typc 使用示例 left exploded view (same SKU as this download).

geometry.scale_check: GLB is meters; mesh bbox about 7.60 x 7.60 x 0.90 mm matches cylinder radii (outer r=3.8, inner r=2.05) and thickness z=0 to 0.9. VERTEX_POINT is incomplete (Y only 0 to 1.117) and must not be used as the solid height or AABB.
measured_features_for_later_manual_matin: Hole axis is the file Z axis, centered at x=0, y=0.

Outer radius 3.8 mm (Ø7.6). Inner radius 2.05 mm (Ø4.10). Mesh Z only has 0.0 and 0.9, so this official solid is a planar split ring of thickness 0.9 mm, not a 3D helical free-height spring. Do not invent a free height, working load, or torque from this file.

A split is visible in the mesh (about 10° of angular gap in the tessellation, near the +X side). That is a measured mesh gap, not a verified standard opening dimension. Slight Y-max shortfall (3.7975 vs 3.8) is consistent with the gap cutting a sliver of the ring.
Explode / stack direction in file coordinates: along Z.

placement_axes_for_explode.shape_note: Planar split ring in the official STEP/mesh; not a helical sprung solid.
